# fjordrun_ssh_keys (Data Source)

The public SSH keys on your account. Needs a personal access token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_ssh_keys" "mine" {}

output "fingerprints" {
  value = data.fjordrun_ssh_keys.mine.keys[*].fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
